verdict.rationale: Fellow documents webhooks that POST event notifications to a URL you specify, but the integrator must supply the receiving endpoint and all action logic. The evidence explicitly notes that no in-product rules engine for trigger-action configuration is documented. Webhooks are a developer building block for constructing automation, not a user-definable rule system, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
